note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: List the name, date and result of each battle.
What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'

questions.question: What are the name and results of the battles when the bulgarian commander is not 'Boril'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  RESULT FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander != 'Boril'

questions.question: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10

questions.question: What are the distinct battle names which are between bulgarian commander 'Kaloyan' and latin commander 'Baldwin I'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander  =  'Kaloyan' AND latin_commander  =  'Baldwin I'

questions.question: How many different results are there for the battles?
How many battles did not lose any ship with tonnage '225'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM battle WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE tonnage  =  '225' );
